notes: Prerelease 3.0.0-beta.4 is a test version of Printer Bot 3.0 and it can have mistakes. It needs no new import. A Hype Train that never gets its End event now prints its end receipt by itself (see Advanced, Hype Train end wait) and needs Streamer.bot 1.0.4 or newer. The dock warns about printers that may not take ESC/POS, with a Check this printer button, and holds back a printer whose job is stuck. The Test card has a new switch, Follow the rules, and the card of printer 1 closes like the other cards. Reload the dock after the update.
